profile.summary:
I am a team player, passionate and hardworking. I enjoy being on a team and working towards a common goal.

I love to code, and I love looking for something new to learn and challenge myself with every week. 

My past experience was in retail, mostly spent in sales. I developed my communication skills, people skills, and the ability to work well with a team.

Current Stack: JavaScript, Python, React / Redux, Flask, Express, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, HTML5, CSS3.
